Mobile App Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 2026

This privacy policy applies to the DD HRMS mobile application ("Application") created by DDIPL. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our Application.

1. Information We Collect

  • Location Data: The Application requests access to your device's location (GPS) specifically for attendance tracking. Location data is only recorded when you actively "Check In" or "Check Out", or when required by your company's geofencing policies.
  • Camera and Photos: The Application may request access to your device's camera or photo library for features like facial recognition attendance, scanning QR codes, or uploading receipts for expense claims.
  • Device Information: We may collect non-personal information about your device, such as the operating system and app version, to help us troubleshoot issues.

2. Use of Information

The information we collect is strictly used to provide HR and attendance services to your employer. Your data is not sold to third parties or used for advertising purposes.

3. Security

We implement industry-standard security measures to safeguard your personal information while it is being transmitted to our servers and once we receive it.

4. Your Rights

You may revoke location or camera permissions at any time through your device's settings. However, doing so may limit your ability to use certain features of the Application, such as checking in for attendance.

5. Contact

If you have any questions regarding privacy while using the Application, please contact your company's HR department.
